description: Header file defining the Switch configuration API (user space part), including data structures, enums, and function prototypes for switch management and attribute handling.

methods.name: swlib_print_portmap
methods.description: Prints port mapping for a switch device.

methods.name: swlib_connect
methods.description: Connects to a switch via netlink, returning a chain of switch_dev structures.

methods.name: swlib_free
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated data for a switch connection.

methods.name: swlib_free_all
methods.description: Frees all switch devices in the chain.

methods.name: swlib_scan
methods.description: Probes the switch driver for available commands and attributes.

methods.name: swlib_lookup_attr
methods.description: Looks up a switch attribute by name and group.

methods.name: swlib_set_attr
methods.description: Sets the value for a switch attribute.

methods.name: swlib_set_attr_string
methods.description: Sets the value for an attribute with string conversion.

methods.name: swlib_get_attr
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a switch attribute.

methods.name: swlib_apply_from_uci
methods.description: Configures switch settings from a UCI package.
